explicitInput.esql_query:
FROM .workflows-executions
| WHERE startedAt >= ?_tstart AND startedAt < ?_tend
| EVAL run_type = CASE(COALESCE(isTestRun, false), "test", "production")
| STATS BY run_type
| SORT run_type
explicitInput.title: Run type

explicitInput.esql_query:

| WHERE startedAt >= ?_tstart AND startedAt < ?_tend
| STATS BY spaceId
| SORT spaceId
